neighbours.label: 'not' negating an adjective or participle predicate ('is not overcrowded', 'and not conducted'), as opposed to do-support negation of a verb ('did not answer'), which stays low
fire: Check that the cage is clean and not crowded before you add the new birds.
The meeting room was cold and not cleaned since the last event.
Make sure the soup is hot but not boiling when you serve it.
The results are preliminary and not yet published in a journal.
The tickets were cheap and not refundable after the first week.
The bridge is old and not considered safe for heavy trucks.
This version of the story is simply not accurate.
The files should be encrypted and not stored on a shared drive.
quiet: Check that the cage is clean and add the new birds one at a time.
The meeting room was cold, so we moved to the café across the street.
Make sure you stir the soup slowly when you serve it.
The researchers did not publish the results in a journal.
The tickets were cheap, and we bought them in the first week.
The town does not allow heavy trucks on the old bridge.
The author did not finish this version of the story.
The files should be encrypted and stored on a separate drive.
